run_post_process_pipeline: run the post-processing pipeline for a named dataset including white balance, downscaling, and JPEG export
run_white_balance_computation: run white balance computation on CC detection JSON files using compute_whitebalance.py
run_jpeg_export: run JPEG export for full resolution and downsampled image folders across capture indices 40 to 53
run_metashape_processing: run Metashape processing in two stages with rig configuration, filtering, and COLMAP export
run_colmap_downscaling: run COLMAP image downscaling at 0.5, 0.25, and 0.125 scale factors for images_2, images_4, and images_8
